title: HPC infrastructure discovery (three speakers)
notes: Three-speaker call (facilitator + Marcus + Elena). Evidence turn_index is 0-based into transcript.turns; quotes are verbatim substrings of a non-facilitator turn.

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Increase compute throughput and cut queue wait at a predictable, defensible cost.

evidence.quote: Researchers wait days in the queue

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Provide fair-share scheduling with preemption so one job cannot starve others.

evidence.quote: can't fair-share across teams, so one big job starves everyone

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Provide a parallel filesystem that scales past the current NFS I/O ceiling (~40 nodes).

evidence.quote: can't feed more than about forty nodes before it falls over

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: The design must accommodate a path to a low-latency fabric (InfiniBand) for tightly-coupled jobs.

evidence.quote: have a path to a low-latency fabric

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Enforce auditable multi-tenant isolation on both compute and storage.

evidence.quote: We need enforced tenant separation on both compute and storage

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: On-prem is viable only if three-year total cost beats cloud (predictable spend).

evidence.quote: only if the three-year total cost beats cloud

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Any on-prem build is gated by data-center power and cooling capacity.

evidence.quote: Our room is provisioned for maybe twelve per rack

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: Patient-derived genomic data must be auditable from day one (top-ranked constraint).

evidence.quote: Whatever we choose has to be auditable from day one

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: The tightly-coupled protein-folding initiative is a committed, board-approved direction.

evidence.quote: The board approved a protein-folding initiative last quarter

gold_artifacts.canonical_statement: An on-prem build is a facilities project (liquid cooling) on a months-not-weeks timeline.

evidence.quote: it's a facilities project with liquid cooling, and that timeline is months not weeks
